intro: Forty years of coating work in Berwick does not photograph the way a finished building does — most of what leaves this plant goes straight into someone else's assembly line. What you can see here is the plant itself: the automated powder booth and its sixteen robotic guns, the barrel plating line, the room-sized batch booth and blast tunnel, the onsite laboratory where we certify what we ship, and the trucks that bring it back to you. Vehicle frames and chassis components, fasteners by the barrel, agricultural equipment, motorcycle and sprint car frames, snowplow blades, wrought iron, commercial railing, tanks, trailers and government components on CARC spec have all run through these lines.
